name: Xixuegui Daxiaojie Xiang he Wo Tanlian'ai
original_name: 吸血鬼大小姐想和我恋爱
source:
Ms Vampire Love to Date with Me is a multi-ending romance-raising ADV that simulates protagonist Tang Jun’s 30-day cohabitation with Irene, a self-proclaimed vampire girlfriend, in a castle. Despite Tang Jun having no memory of her, Irene insists they are lovers. Players must interact with her to stabilize her emotional and physical states while uncovering the truth she hides. Over 30 days, players may face catastrophic endings. Only by discovering Irene’s secrets and surviving until the end can players make their own choice based on memories forged with her.

As a senior college student, you wake up in a lavish, unfamiliar castle. Lifting your head, you meet the gaze of a dreamlike beauty smiling down at you.
“I’m your girlfriend, Irene!”
Though she claims to be ordinary, her nocturnal habits and occasional thirst for your blood hint at something darker. Visions of bloody scenes in your mind suggest the castle harbors terrifying secrets. Despite her flawless façade as a girlfriend, a grim lingers: failing to meet her romantic expectations might turn those visions into reality. Thus, you play the role of her lover while searching for the hidden truth…

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3690570/]Steam[/url]]
